exposure: Admission in active phase of labor
admission in active phase of labour
cohort: Pregnant women in two hospitals in northern Italy
finding: Admission in active labor and one-to-one midwifery care were associated with a decreased likelihood of cesarean section, while unjustified amniorrhexis and oxytocin administration increased the cesarean section rate in low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Admission in active phase of labor and one-to-one care significantly decreased the likelihood of cesarean section, while unjustified amniorrhexis and oxytocin administration increased the rate.
